results.title: Privia Medical Group
results.snippet: Privia says its group is a physician-led, multi-specialty medical group of the nation's top independent physicians. Physicians join the medical group with their private practice, not in a typical employment model.

results.title: What we offer
results.snippet: Practices get access to exclusive contracts, strategically negotiated reimbursements, and value-based care programs. Its approach supports fee-for-service contracts to stabilize practices before advancing into greater risk.

results.title: Technology and Population Health
results.snippet: Independent physicians also get advanced analytics to help identify patients who may need additional support such as care management.

results.title: What's Valuable to You?
results.snippet: Its group negotiates with payers and arranges reimbursement programs that reward doctors for delivering high-value care.

results.title: Key to medical group's success: Letting doctors be doctors
results.snippet: Privia says it offloads admin work so more time can go to value-based care and workflow changes.
